conflict_identified.actual_conflict_or_ambiguity_found: The word-budget formula was stated twice as a 'hard delivery requirement' with no explicit causal direction between end_seconds and word count. A planning AI reading linearly could satisfy the budget mechanically by choosing a SHORTER end_seconds (smaller budget, easier to hit), directly undermining the PICKING end_seconds rules. The formula's forceful framing ('REQUIRED', 'hard delivery requirement', 'never return fewer than 90%') out-weighted the earlier, longer prose rules. Additionally, 'Target the sum of (end - start) across all cuts at roughly {target_duration} seconds' named no mechanism for hitting the total, leaving per-cut truncation available as the easiest lever.
